instagram.caption:
The ugly favourite.
The Blanket and Comfort Zone in the Family Room. Hold the throws and floor cushions people actually reach for while watching or reading, in a container that tells the truth about how many there are.

What done looks like:
1. One basket holding four throws folded to the same rectangle so the fold edges line up
2. Two floor cushions stacked beside it
3. Nothing draped over the sofa back
4. Or the arm of a chair

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success blanket and comfort zone.
